sloka: ततः शर सहस्रेण रामम् अप्रतिम ओजसम् ।अर्दयित्वा महानादम् ननाद समेरे खरः ॥३-२८-१७॥
transliteration: tataḥ śara sahasreṇa rāmam apratima ojasam ।ardayitvā mahānādam nanāda samere kharaḥ ॥3-28-17॥

translations.english: The armour of Rama who looked radiant like the Sun fell on the ground, struck by the welljointed darts released by Khara.
